rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is or may be at any location.

example.english: You can't find this book anywhere.
example.traditional: 呢本書喺邊度都搵唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai2 bin1 dou6 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when the meaning is going to any place or wherever someone goes.

example.english: I take my camera anywhere I go.
example.traditional: 我去邊度都帶住部相機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 dou1 daai3 zyu6 bou6 soeng2 gei1
